bahce-bakim.HERO_DESC: We ensure your green areas, which breathe life into your living spaces, remain healthy, aesthetic, and orderly in every season. You just enjoy nature.
bahce-bakim.F1_D: We keep your green areas fresh with mowing, aeration, and fertilization.
bahce-bakim.F2_D: We add value to common areas with aesthetic and modern landscaping.
bahce-bakim.F3_D: Installation and monitoring of water-saving automatic irrigation systems.
bahce-bakim.F4_D: Seasonal tree pruning, dry leaf cleaning, and plant health checks.
bahce-bakim.PROCESS_DESC: We follow a transparent and professional process from determining the needs of your garden to regular reporting.
bahce-bakim.P1_D: Our expert team visits your area and conducts soil and plant analysis.
bahce-bakim.P2_D: A periodic maintenance schedule tailored to the needs of your garden is created.
bahce-bakim.P3_D: Our experienced gardeners meticulously carry out the planned operations.
bahce-bakim.P4_D: Regular reports on operations performed and the condition of your garden are provided.
bahce-bakim.INFO_TITLE: Your Gardens Are Now in Safe Hands
bahce-bakim.I1_D: A regular maintenance plan on a weekly or monthly basis.
bahce-bakim.I2_D: Determining the most suitable plant species for the climate and soil structure.
bahce-bakim.I3_D: Preventive measures to protect your plants from diseases.

concierge.HERO_DESC: We offer 24/7 personalized assistance services that elevate your living standards and facilitate your daily tasks.
concierge.F1_D: Flight tickets, hotel reservations, and event tickets procurement.
concierge.F2_D: Your clothes are picked up from your door and delivered cleaned.
concierge.F3_D: Airport transfers and vip vehicle allocation for special occasions.
concierge.F4_D: In-house invitations, birthday, and special celebration organizations.
concierge.PROCESS_DESC: We have designed a special process to fulfill your requests in the fastest and most exclusive way.
concierge.P1_D: You submit your request via mobile app or direct line.
concierge.P2_D: Our expert assistants prepare the best options for your request.
concierge.P3_D: Transactions start once you approve the options presented.
concierge.P4_D: Your satisfaction is confirmed when the service is completed.
concierge.I1_D: A dedicated assistant line that responds to your requests around the clock.
concierge.I2_D: We fulfill seemingly impossible requests with our extensive supplier network.
concierge.I3_D: All your special requests are handled with high confidentiality standards.

danisma.HERO_DESC: We welcome everyone stepping into your site with a smile and ensure your peace of mind with a secure filtering system.
danisma.F1_D: Incoming guests are registered, verified, and directed.
danisma.F2_D: Your packages are safely received, and you are informed instantly.
danisma.F3_D: Escrow key tracking for renovations and similar situations.
danisma.F4_D: The primary contact point where all requests and complaints of residents are collected.
danisma.PROCESS_DESC: We manage a flawless reception process that offers both security and comfort together.
danisma.P1_D: All visitors are welcomed with a smile and professionalism.
danisma.P2_D: The relevant resident is called to verify the visitor.
danisma.P3_D: Verified guests or deliveries are directed to the correct address.
danisma.P4_D: All entry-exit transactions are digitally recorded.
danisma.I1_D: Professionals trained in diction, communication, and crisis management.
danisma.I2_D: Instant digital logging of all entries and exits.
danisma.I3_D: A synchronized working structure with the physical security team.

denetim-raporlama.HERO_DESC: With our independent audit mechanism, we ensure full compliance of management processes with legal and financial regulations.
denetim-raporlama.F1_D: Detailed examination of income-expense tables, cash, and bank transactions.
denetim-raporlama.F2_D: Auditing decision books and contracts for compliance with legal regulations.
denetim-raporlama.F3_D: Checking SSI, OHS, and payroll records of employees.
denetim-raporlama.F4_D: Periodic tracking of fixture maintenance such as plumbing, elevator, pool.
denetim-raporlama.PROCESS_DESC: We offer a completely objective and document-based audit process leaving no room for question marks.
denetim-raporlama.P1_D: All financial and administrative documents for the relevant period are collected.
denetim-raporlama.P2_D: Documents are examined in detail by our expert auditors.
denetim-raporlama.P3_D: Missing or incorrect transactions are identified, and solutions are offered.
denetim-raporlama.P4_D: Prepared in the format of a board of auditors report and presented to the residents.
denetim-raporlama.INFO_TITLE: Transparency is the Foundation of Trust
denetim-raporlama.I1_D: Objective review by experts independent of the management.
denetim-raporlama.I2_D: Transparent tables that everyone can understand instead of complex accounting jargon.
denetim-raporlama.I3_D: Comparative analysis with previous periods to foresee risks.

site-danismanlik.HERO_DESC: We guide you in establishing and operating the entire management structure from the project stage to the start of life.
site-danismanlik.F1_D: Preparation of a management plan best suited to your site's structure, leaving no legal loopholes.
site-danismanlik.F2_D: Fair and realistic calculation of the operating project (dues).
site-danismanlik.F3_D: Organizing meetings and making decisions in accordance with the law.
site-danismanlik.F4_D: Determining the personnel staff and creating job descriptions.
site-danismanlik.PROCESS_DESC: We make complex property ownership processes simple, legal, and applicable for you.
site-danismanlik.P1_D: The physical and administrative current situation of your site is analyzed.
site-danismanlik.P2_D: A legal and financial roadmap is drawn up for identified needs.
site-danismanlik.P3_D: Actions to be taken are presented to the management in order of priority.
site-danismanlik.P4_D: It is monitored whether the decisions post-consultancy are applied correctly.
site-danismanlik.INFO_TITLE: The Secret of Successful Management is a Right Start
site-danismanlik.I1_D: A professional team fully mastering the Property Ownership Law (KMK).
site-danismanlik.I2_D: Fair dues distribution models based on land share and usage areas.
site-danismanlik.I3_D: Contract structures that prevent future disputes from the beginning.

site-hukuk.HERO_DESC: Fast resolution of all legal disputes encountered on your site, dues tracking, and management of legal processes by our expert lawyers.
site-hukuk.F1_D: Collection of unpaid dues and fixture fees through legal means.
site-hukuk.F2_D: Preparation of supplier, elevator, maintenance, and personnel contracts.
site-hukuk.F3_D: Pre-trial resolution of neighborhood law violations and disputes.
site-hukuk.F4_D: Defense or cancellation processes against unlawful general assembly decisions.
site-hukuk.PROCESS_DESC: We follow the processes with the precision and speed prescribed by the laws so that you do not suffer a loss of rights.
site-hukuk.P1_D: An official warning letter is sent in case of a dispute or debt.
site-hukuk.P2_D: When the periods expire, enforcement proceedings or the relevant case file is opened.
site-hukuk.P3_D: Our expert lawyers handle all hearing and foreclosure processes.
site-hukuk.P4_D: The result obtained or the collection is transferred to the site accounts.
site-hukuk.I1_D: A legal unit specializing in Real Estate and Property Ownership law.
site-hukuk.I2_D: Periodic reports on the latest status of your lawsuit and enforcement files.
site-hukuk.I3_D: Processing of resident information in compliance with the Personal Data Protection Law.

site-muhasebe.HERO_DESC: We record all income and expenses of your site with a zero-error principle and transparently account for every penny.
site-muhasebe.F1_D: Instant processing of debt/credit status of residents into the system.
site-muhasebe.F2_D: Making common area electricity, water, natural gas, and supplier payments.
site-muhasebe.F3_D: Preparation and notification of the estimated budget for the upcoming period.
site-muhasebe.F4_D: Keeping and certifying operating and decision books in accordance with the laws.
site-muhasebe.PROCESS_DESC: We manage a digital and auditable financial flow that eliminates manual errors.
site-muhasebe.P1_D: At the beginning of each month, dues and other expenses are accrued to resident accounts.
site-muhasebe.P2_D: Incoming payments are processed, site debts are paid on time.
site-muhasebe.P3_D: Bank accounts and accounting records are compared regularly.
site-muhasebe.P4_D: Monthly income-expense tables are published on boards and in the app.
site-muhasebe.I1_D: Automatic accounting software integrated with bank accounts.
site-muhasebe.I2_D: Residents can view their own statements via the mobile application.
site-muhasebe.I3_D: Applying delay interest/compensation to delayed payments at the legal rate.

teknik.HERO_DESC: We prevent surprise breakdowns by regularly maintaining the mechanical, electrical, and automation systems of your buildings.
teknik.F1_D: Management of monthly periodic maintenance and the green label (safe) process.
teknik.F2_D: Winter/summer preparation maintenance of central heating and hydrophore systems.
teknik.F3_D: Adjustment of pool chemicals, cleaning, and engine maintenance.
teknik.F4_D: Control of common area lighting, generator, and camera systems.
teknik.PROCESS_DESC: We do not wait for a malfunction; we detect and solve problems in advance with our preventive maintenance plans.
teknik.P1_D: All systems are checked regularly according to the determined schedule.
teknik.P2_D: Worn parts are identified, and approval is obtained from management for replacement.
teknik.P3_D: Repairs are made by our certified technicians or authorized services.
teknik.P4_D: The system is tested and recorded as fully operational.
teknik.I1_D: 24/7 rapid response in situations like water bursts or power outages.
teknik.I2_D: Technicians who have completed occupational safety training and hold professional competence certificates.
teknik.I3_D: Preventing energy waste by ensuring the optimum operation of the systems.

temizlik.HERO_DESC: We make your living spaces healthier and more spacious by providing high-level hygiene standards in your common areas.
temizlik.F1_D: Periodic cleaning of stairs, elevators, windows, and corridors.
temizlik.F2_D: Machine washing and sweeping of indoor and outdoor parking areas.
temizlik.F3_D: Polishing and protective maintenance of surfaces like marble and granite.
temizlik.F4_D: Hygienic collection of garbage from apartment doors at designated times.
temizlik.PROCESS_DESC: We use professional chemicals and equipment suitable for the surface type and usage density of the area.
temizlik.P1_D: A daily, weekly, and monthly cleaning schedule is created based on the dirt density of the areas.
temizlik.P2_D: An appropriate number of trained cleaning staff is assigned based on the site size.
temizlik.P3_D: Detailed hygiene application is made with TSE certified cleaning products.
temizlik.P4_D: The quality of work done is regularly audited by our field supervisors.
temizlik.INFO_TITLE: Your Health is Important to Us
temizlik.I1_D: Use of ecological cleaning chemicals harmless to human health.
temizlik.I2_D: Use of different colored cloths and equipment for different areas (WC, kitchen, floor).
temizlik.I3_D: Detailed top-to-bottom disinfection and cleaning operation twice a year.

web-tasarim.HERO_DESC: We develop modern websites and management panels that reflect your site's corporate identity and offer digital conveniences to your residents.
web-tasarim.F1_D: A promotional page introducing your site with a mobile-friendly and modern design.
web-tasarim.F2_D: Debt viewing and payment screens logged in with a personalized password.
web-tasarim.F3_D: Instant malfunction notification system via the site management panel.
web-tasarim.F4_D: Ability to make announcements to all site residents with one click via e-mail or SMS.
web-tasarim.PROCESS_DESC: We design it specifically for you from scratch, code it with the latest technologies, provide user training, and deliver.
web-tasarim.P1_D: The digital expectations and required modules of your site are determined.
web-tasarim.P2_D: A user experience-focused design suitable for your corporate identity is prepared.
web-tasarim.P3_D: A secure infrastructure is coded and tested on different devices.
web-tasarim.P4_D: The system is launched, and usage training is provided to management personnel.
web-tasarim.I1_D: Responsive design that looks flawless on phones and tablets.
web-tasarim.I2_D: High-level protection of resident information with SSL certificate and data encryption.
web-tasarim.I3_D: Maintenance and support service for technical issues that may arise post-launch.
